# Leopards Courier Services

> > Pakistan and UAE's leading courier and logistics provider offering express delivery, ecommerce fulfillment, document attestation, and digital services.

Leopards Courier Services operates comprehensive supply chain solutions across Pakistan and UAE, including the Leopards Express overnight COD network, Express Centers for MOFA attestation and government document services, warehousing and fulfillment operations, and digital marketing services for ecommerce businesses. Led by executives Jehangir Shahid and Rizwan Saadat, the company serves both B2B logistics clients and retail customers through its GiftWifts brand.

## Key Topics

- Leopards Courier Services
- Pakistan courier network
- UAE logistics operations
- COD delivery (Cash on Delivery)
- Ecommerce fulfillment
- MOFA attestation and apostille
- National Police Bureau (NPB) certificates
- Leopards Express Center
- GiftWifts by Leopards
- Supply chain management
- Overnight delivery services
- Document verification
- Warehousing and distribution
- Digital marketing solutions
- Express delivery network
